result.type: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ (Real.log 4 + ε) * x / Real.log x

result.informal_name: Von Mangoldt function in residue class $ a \mod q $
result.informal_description: The function $ \Lambda_{a,q}(n) $ defined as $ \Lambda(n) $ if $ n \equiv a \mod q $, and 0 otherwise, where $ \Lambda(n) $ is the von Mangoldt function. This restricts the von Mangoldt function to natural numbers congruent to $ a $ modulo $ q $.
